summary: UP Fintech Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K on August 26, 2026, containing a press release of its unaudited second quarter 2026 financial results. The release reports record total revenue of US$182.3 million, operating income of US$56.8 million, and GAAP net income of US$39.4 million, turning around from prior-quarter losses. It also details operational metrics: 32,600 new funded clients, total funded accounts of 1,315,400, client assets of US$60.7 billion, and net inflows over $1.5 billion. The filing is a routine quarterly earnings announcement with no special-situation elements, transaction terms, or strategic actions.
